vedic_reference.note: In Hinduism, the name Dhara is derived from the Sanskrit word धारा (dhārā), which means 'support' or 'carrier'. The name is also associated with the Hindu goddess Dharani, who is the goddess of the earth and is believed to support and sustain all living beings. The name Dhara is also used in various Hindu scriptures, such as the Mahabharata and the Puranas, to refer to various characters who hold or support important roles or duties.
